items.bridge: The typed Contact workflow is canonical from exact private input through current schema observation, exact option matching, optional organization resolution, email-or-name duplicate checks, private proposal, exact approval, single-use start, contained person-create result, and read-after-write verification. Prompt-only no-invention and confirmation discipline are intentionally replaced by mechanical contracts.

The target preserves exact current-option selection, optional organization resolution, email-or-name duplicate checks, complete private review, and explicit confirmation. Fixture evidence covers the contained transaction without claiming live provider behavior.

The target accepts Role, Status, Disposition, Authority, and Tag values only by exact case-insensitive match against the current normalized schema. Unmatched optional values are omitted and surfaced rather than invented.

The target cannot guess a requested Role absent from the current schema and cannot promote vague supportive language to Champion. It cannot skip policy, schema, duplicate, review, or confirmation boundaries under pressure.

Only the Contact Capture orchestration responsibility inside this mixed source is target-owned. The exact CRM card remains present and legacy-authoritative for broader portable CRM and provider-translation responsibilities while its frozen Contact guide path is governed migration residue.
